The no-route test (isNoRoute in dispatch-http.ts) keys on 404 NOT_FOUND with a message starting `no route for `, which the Go router answers for an unknown route; a 404 NOT_FOUND for an unknown project says `not found` and must stay an error, so the fallback never turns an unknown project into `no model`.

The dispatch CLI prints a dashboard link from its own configuration; logs posted on this public repository's pull request have the tailnet host replaced by example-tailnet (a first post that carried it was deleted at once).

GitHub's commits/{ref} resolves any commit-ish; git/ref/heads/{name} is exact (404 for main~1, HEAD, refs/heads/main, a prefix, and an escaped foo%2F..%2Fx). The unescaped `..` form is normalized by GitHub, which is why the name is path-escaped whole and the answered ref is compared to refs/heads/<branch>.
